LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SettingIntakeSepara: On by default: turboprop aircraft and helicopters get an intake separator switch on their Dashboard. On, it keeps out half the dust, grit and compressor dirt for about 3% more asked of the engines; by default it switches itself on over rough ground. A fitted inlet barrier filter instead clogs on rough ground, costing more power until a compressor wash cleans it. Off: no switch, and the barrier never clogs.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SeparatorButtonDesc: Throws dust and grit out of the engines' intakes, at about 3% more asked of the engines. Press to go from automatic (on over rough ground) to held on, to held off, and back.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SeparatorSetToAutom: The {VEHICLE}'s intake separator is on automatic: on over rough ground, off elsewhere.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SeparatorSetToOn: The {VEHICLE}'s intake separator is held on: dust is kept out everywhere, for a little power.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_SeparatorSetToOff: The {VEHICLE}'s intake separator is held off: full power, and the engines take all the dust.
LanguageData.PhobosVehicleSystems_MsgBarrierClogged: The {VEHICLE}'s inlet barrier filter is clogged with dust and costing power. A compressor wash cleans it.
